module.name: ibm_roks_bnk_license
module.description: Deploy the BIG-IP Next License custom resource onto an existing IBM ROKS cluster using the upstream license module.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to access the target cluster and optional COS resources.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the existing ROKS cluster resides.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Name or ID of the existing IBM ROKS cluster where the License resource will be installed.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used to discover the target cluster and optional COS instance.

optional.name: flo_utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where the License custom resource is deployed.

optional.name: license_mode
optional.description: License operation mode for the BNK License custom resource.

optional.name: use_cos_bucket
optional.description: Whether the JWT token should be fetched from IBM Cloud Object Storage instead of passed directly.

optional.name: jwt_token
optional.description: Direct JWT token for license authentication when COS is not used.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_bucket_region
optional.description: IBM Cloud region where the COS bucket is located.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_instance_name
optional.description: IBM Cloud COS instance name containing the license JWT file.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resources_cos_bucket
optional.description: COS bucket containing the license JWT file.

optional.name: f5_cne_subscription_jwt_file
optional.description: License JWT filename in the COS bucket.

key_outputs.name: target_cluster_name_or_id
key_outputs.description: Name or ID of the existing target cluster passed into the wrapper.

key_outputs.name: license_id
key_outputs.description: Name of the created License custom resource.

key_outputs.name: license_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where the License custom resource is deployed.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
